user_reported_bug: Production 'window.Razorpay is not a constructor' and 'Failed to create payment order' errors on My Service Charges. Iteration 298 confirmed the main fix works (all 3 payment paths open Razorpay checkout). Only remaining regression: when checkout.js CDN is blocked/fails, ensureRazorpayLoaded() left the failed script tag in DOM and hung silently without surfacing an error toast.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused retest inspected the v1.4.2 Razorpay loader code, ran the requested 36 backend pytests successfully, and executed UI CDN-block tests against seeded pending service charges. Row Pay Now and Bulk Pay All now show clear Razorpay loader error toasts for aborted CDN, and row also shows the 12s timeout toast for a silently hanging CDN. However the required banner Pay Rs.300 user action still produces no toast within 15s in real browser hit-testing because the fixed TopBar overlays the banner CTA; the click event count stayed 0, so the user-visible banner path is still not fixed.

ui_bugs.issue: The banner Pay button is rendered at the top of the viewport with z-40 while TopBar is fixed at top with z-50. Hit testing showed the visible Pay Rs.300 area is covered by TopBar controls (Language/Search/Bell), so a real click does not reach data-testid='banner-pay-btn'.

integration_issues.flow: My Service Charges banner Pay with checkout.js blocked/failed
integration_issues.issue: Actual Playwright click on banner Pay after blocking https://checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js showed no toast within 15s and no payment handler console error. Debug instrumentation confirmed click count remained 0. A synthetic dispatch directly on the button does show the expected toast, so the loader patch works when invoked, but the user-visible banner CTA is currently obstructed.

action_items: Fix the ServiceChargePendingBanner placement/z-index relative to TopBar so the real banner Pay CTA receives pointer events on /my-service-charges.

After layout fix, retest actual banner Pay with checkout.js aborted and silently hanging; require a non-empty toast containing 'Razorpay checkout.js failed to load' or 'Razorpay checkout.js load timed out' within 15s.
Strengthen the happy-path UI test to verify the payment click handler was reached and the checkout modal opened, not only that a Razorpay iframe exists after SDK preload.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/lib/razorpay.js contains the intended cleanup and 12s timeout behavior; row/bulk UI evidence confirms both aborted-CDN and timeout errors surface through Sonner toasts without any 'window.Razorpay is not a constructor' text.

/app/frontend/src/components/ServiceChargePendingBanner.jsx renders sticky top-0 z-40, but /app/frontend/src/components/TopBar.js uses fixed top-0 z-50. This leaves the banner button physically covered by TopBar controls in the tested preview viewport, preventing the user action from reaching ensureRazorpayLoaded().

rca_of_the_issue: Reproduction: seed one pending service charge, block checkout.js, open /my-service-charges, then click banner Pay Rs.300. Result: no toast. Debug RCA: document.elementFromPoint over the banner Pay button returns TopBar controls (Language/Search/Bell), and a capture listener on banner-pay-btn records zero clicks. Programmatic dispatch to the same button then makes a second checkout.js request and surfaces 'Cannot open payment gateway (Razorpay checkout.js failed to load - check network / CDN)', proving the loader catch path is working but the actual banner CTA is obstructed.
